subject: Malon's obstacle course
text: Waking Talon as part of the Biggoron Sword sequence allows Link to race Epona around Malon's course.

evidence.quote: If you've awoken Talon as part of the Biggoron Sword Trading Sequence, then he will have returned to the Ranch, and Malon will now let you participate in a time trial run around the course on Epona.

subject: Cow
text: Beating Malon's best time around the course rewards Link with a personal Cow delivered to Link's House in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Complete the course and beat Malon's best time, and Malon will reward you with your own personal Cow back at Link's House in Kokiri Forest.

subject: Malon's obstacle course
text: To clear the course, hug the inside wall, use a carrot before each hurdle, use only one carrot for the pair of low hurdles, recover carrots before the final hurdle, and burn all carrots on the final leg.

evidence.quote: To complete the course, hug the inside wall and use a Carrot just before each hurdle in the fence (for the pair of extremely low hurdles one-third of the way through the course, only use one carrot to clear them both.  Use the long, empty stretch before the last hurdle to recover your carrots.  On the last leg of the second lap, burn all of your carrots in one go.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: Sheik teaches the Prelude of Light inside the Master Sword chamber.

evidence.quote: Run back into the Master Sword chamber, and Sheik will teach you the Prelude of Light.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: Playing the Prelude of Light warps Link straight to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: This song will warp you straight to the Temple of Time, much in the same way that the Minuet of Forest takes you straight to the Forest Temple.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: The reward for collecting 40 Gold Skulltula tokens in the House of Skulltula is Bombchus.

evidence.quote: Also, if you skipped the 40 Skulltula reward, get it now.  Which is Bombchus.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Hitting all targets in one run at the adult Shooting Gallery across from the windmill rewards the first Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: Head for the building across from the Windmill, which was the unfinished structure in Link's childhood.  Enter it....Keep playing the game until you nail all of the targets in one go, and the clerk will reward you with the first Quiver upgrade.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Targets in the adult Shooting Gallery appear in the following pattern: middle, left then right, jumping from middle, left and right simultaneously, two rupees from right moving left, and two rupees from left moving right.

evidence.quote:
The order is as follows:
1.)  In the middle
2.)  From the left, then from the right
3.)  Jumps from the middle
4.)  From the left AND right
5.)  Two rupees coming from the right, going left
6.)  Two rupees coming from the left, going right

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: If a single blue rupee appears from the left, the next target will always come from the right.

evidence.quote: Note number 2: if a single blue rupee comes from the left, then the next one will ALWAYS come from the right, despite the randomness of the rest of it.

subject: Death Mountain Trail
text: Ascending Death Mountain Trail requires dodging crashing boulders along the path from the foot of the trail.

evidence.quote: Go up the path from the foot of Death Mountain Trail, dodging the boulders that come crashing down along the way.

subject: Antechamber
text: From the Dodongo Skull platform in the Antechamber, take the right elevator, jump onto the lower ledge, and follow the southern darkened tunnel on the left.

evidence.quote: Run forward, out to the elevator and to the middle platform in front of the giant Dodongo Skull.  Go to the right onto the next elevator, and jump out to the lower ledge (do not ride the elevator up).  Once on the ledge, head back towards the southern edge of the room and go through the darkened tunnel on the left at the south edge of the ledge.

subject: Baby Dodongo
text: A trio of Baby Dodongos emerge from the ground in the Lower Southeast Hall and explode upon defeat.

evidence.quote: Run forward into the hall, and kill the trio of Baby Dodongo's who come out of the ground.  Remember to watch out; they explode.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song summons Pierre the Scarecrow to a high cliff, allowing Link to Hookshot up and kill the Gold Skulltula behind him.

evidence.quote: Stop and play the Scarecrow's Song.  Pierre the Scarecrow will magically appear on the cliff above.  Use the Hookshot on Pierre to pull yourself up onto the cliff, and kill the Gold Skulltula behind Pierre.  Take it's token, then return to the start of the dungeon by walking or using Farore's Wind.

subject: Magic Leaf
text: Riding the grown Magic Leaf outside Dodongo's Cavern transports Link directly up to Goron City.

evidence.quote: Go back out to Death Mountain Trail and use the Magic Leaf out front of Dodongo's Cavern to ride up to Goron City (the Leaf won't be there if you didn't plant the Magic Bean as Young Link, in which case you'll have to walk).

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula clings to the back of the platform suspended over Goron City, reachable by climbing out onto the ropes and using the Hookshot at night.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song to make it nighttime if you need to, then run down the rope bridges to the platform suspended over the middle of Goron City.  There is a Gold Skulltula clinging to the back of this platform.  Go to one of the ropes on the left or right sides of the platform, and climb out far enough so that you can see the Skulltula on the back of the platform.  Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Link, Darunia's Son
text: Stopping the Goron rolling around the third floor using Bombs or Bombchus reveals him to be Link, Darunia's Son.

evidence.quote: Look down to the third floor (the level immediately beneath Goron City's top floor), and you'll see a tiny little Goron rolling around there, much like the Biggoron used to do as Young Link.  Jump down, and try to blow up the Goron using Bombs to make him stop....Speak with the Goron, and he'll reveal himself to be Link, Darunia's Son.

subject: Goron Tunic
text: Talking to Link, Darunia's Son about the Dragon and the Gorons rewards Link with the Goron Tunic and opens Darunia's Chamber.

evidence.quote: Ask him about the Dragon when prompted, and he'll stop crying long enough to explain.  He'll then start crying again.  Ask him about the Gorons, and he'll stop crying again, and ask you to save them.  He'll then give you the Goron Tunic, and the door to Darunia's Chamber will open.

subject: Goron Tunic
text: Equipping the Goron Tunic eliminates the environmental heat timer in Death Mountain Crater and the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote: Put on the Goron Tunic, which removes the time limit in Death Mountain Crater and the Fire Temple.

subject: Darunia's Chamber
text: Pulling back the large carved stone Goron block at the back of Darunia's Chamber opens a passage to Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: In the back of Darunia's Chamber, there is a large stone block with a crude carving of a Goron on it.  Grab onto the block and pull back to reveal a doorway.  Go through it.

subject: broken bridge
text: Hookshotting the wooden beam above the far side of the broken bridge pulls Link across the chasm in Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: Go to the left as you enter the Crater, and you will find a broken bridge.  Stand on the edge of the bridge, and use the Hookshot to pull yourself across using the wooden beam hanging above the other side of the bridge as an anchor.

subject: Bolero of Fire
text: Sheik appears across the bridge in Death Mountain Crater to teach Link the Bolero of Fire.

evidence.quote: Run down the bridge a short ways, and Sheik will appear to teach your the Bolero of Fire, the song that warps you to the Fire Temple at any time.

subject: Master Sword pedestal
text: Placing the Master Sword back into its pedestal reverts Link back to childhood.

evidence.quote: Run back into the Master Sword chamber, and replace the Master Sword on it's pedestal to return to Link's childhood.

subject: ivy wall and marble arch
text: Climbing the ivy wall and jumping down from the large marble arch allows Link to land past the locked gate and sneak past two guards.

evidence.quote: Climb up the ivy wall to the top (it has some rough spots where if you don't climb up in just the right place, you'll fall off).  At the top, run forward a bit, past the gossip stone, to the top of the large marble arch.  Drop down to the ground on the other side of the arch, where you will land on the other side of the gate which formerly blocked your path.  You probably don't realize it, but you've already snuck past two of the guards.

subject: garden hill and moat
text: Running up the third break in the hill toward the flowers leads to a brick wall that links to the moat and the stone platform beyond.

evidence.quote: The place you need to run up is the third break in the hill, approximately near it's center.  Go straight up the hill, and at the top there is a cluster of flowers.  Run straight at these flowers, then begin running forward and slightly to the left until you reach a wall.  Part of the wall is tiled with some bricks; climb up these bricks....Jump straight off the cliff, and go right into the moat.  Swim down to the end of the moat until it breaks left, then climb up onto the small patch of dirt, and from there climb up to the stone platform.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Playing the Song of Storms under the tree by the moat opens a secret pit where bombing the left wall reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: As you climb out of the moat, there is a tree to your right sitting at the corner of the fence.  Stand beneath this tree and play the Song of Storms to make a pit appear.  Drop down into this pit.  There are three bombable walls in this pit, one in front of you as you enter, one to the left and one to the right.  Bomb the wall on the left (it's slightly behind you from where you land), to reveal a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token, then return to the Garden.

subject: Castle Guard
text: Allowing a guard in the garden to spot Link causes the guard to throw him outside the gate.

evidence.quote: Run back in the opposite direction you came from while riding the moat and allow one of the Guards to spot you.  The guard will throw you back outside the gate.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: The reward for Fifty Skulltulas in the House of Skulltula is a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Get the reward for Fifty Skulltulas, which is a Piece of Heart.
